_source: ADR 5.3.2.3 — Hazard identification number / Kemler number (API field: hazardId)

general_rules.structure: 2 or 3 digits, sometimes preceded by the letter X.

digit_meaning.2: emission of gas due to pressure or to chemical reaction
digit_meaning.3: flammability of liquids (vapours) and gases, or self-heating liquid
digit_meaning.4: flammability of solids, or self-heating solid
digit_meaning.9: risk of spontaneous violent reaction (explosion, decomposition, polymerization with release of heat/gas)

general_rules.repeated_digit: A repeated digit indicates an intensification of that particular hazard (e.g. 33 = highly flammable liquid, stronger than 30).
general_rules.zero_digit: If the hazard is adequately indicated by a single digit, it is supplemented by a zero (e.g. 20, 30, 40...).
general_rules.letter_X: Prefix "X" means the substance reacts dangerously with water; water may be used only with the agreement of specialists.
general_rules.class_1: For Class 1 substances, the hazard identification number is the classification code (division + compatibility group), not a value from the table below.
general_rules.note: The table below is the full list of combinations from the treaty (5.3.2.3.2) — the hazardId API field returns a value taken directly from this list, so it is a plain lookup and does not need digit-by-digit decoding.

codes.323: flammable liquid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X323: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.X333: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.X338: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.339: highly flammable liquid which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.36: flammable liquid (flash point between 23°C and 60°C), slightly toxic, or self-heating liquid, toxic
codes.362: flammable liquid, toxic, which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X362: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.38: flammable liquid (flash point between 23°C and 60°C), slightly corrosive, or self-heating liquid, corrosive
codes.382: flammable liquid, corrosive, which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X382: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.39: flammable liquid which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.40: flammable solid, or self-reactive substance, or self-heating solid, or polymerizing substance
codes.423: flammable solid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X423: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.X432: as above, and reacts dangerously with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.44: flammable solid, molten, at an elevated temperature
codes.446: flammable solid, toxic, molten, at an elevated temperature
codes.46: flammable solid, toxic, or self-heating solid, toxic
codes.462: toxic solid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X462: solid which reacts dangerously with water, emitting toxic gases
codes.48: flammable solid, corrosive, or self-heating solid, corrosive
codes.482: corrosive solid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.X482: solid which reacts dangerously with water, emitting corrosive gases
codes.559: strongly oxidizing substance, which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.59: oxidizing substance which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.623: toxic liquid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.63: toxic substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C)
codes.638: toxic substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C), corrosive
codes.639: toxic substance, flammable (flash point ≤ 60°C), which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.64: toxic solid, flammable, or toxic self-heating solid
codes.642: toxic solid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.664: highly toxic solid, flammable, or self-heating
codes.X668: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.669: highly toxic substance which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.69: toxic or slightly toxic substance which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.X80: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.823: corrosive liquid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.83: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C)
codes.X83: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.836: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C), toxic
codes.839: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C), which can spontaneously lead to violent reaction
codes.X839: as above, and also reacts dangerously with water
codes.84: corrosive solid, flammable, or self-heating corrosive solid
codes.842: corrosive solid which reacts with water, emitting flammable gases
codes.85: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, oxidizing
codes.856: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, oxidizing, toxic
codes.86: corrosive or slightly corrosive substance, toxic
codes.X88: as above, and reacts dangerously with water
codes.883: highly corrosive substance, flammable (flash point between 23°C and 60°C)
